correctness.rationale: All sixteen-vertex bitmasks are exhaustively enumerated for both explicitly defined strongly regular graphs. Every free collapse and subsequent signed integral unit-pivot chain cancellation is checked, with chain-square-zero verification. Zero residual differentials on graded free modules yield full integral, torsion-free neighborhood homology; universal coefficients and n-i-3 integral combinatorial Alexander duality yield dominance ranks 11 in degree 9 for Shrikhande and 1,2 in degrees 9,11 for rook. Independent mod-two ranks, direct dominance membership and Euler checks corroborate. Source: arXiv:2312.02639v1 for duality; standalone verify_dominance_twins.py for exact computations.

value.rationale: The domination complex and its neighborhood-complex Alexander dual are natural algebraic-topological constructions. The canonical cospectral strongly regular (16,6,2,2) twins have equal low-dimensional face counts but sharply distinct full integral homology degree support: one degree for Shrikhande and two for rook. This complete exact finite result is not a routine face count or a substitute for the earlier independence/Čech distinctions. No general or homotopy type assertion is made.
